capabilities: Open a customizable homepage automatically on startup and in new tabs
Pin, reorder, and import bookmarks as pinned notes
List recently modified and accessed notes with relative times
Show vault statistics and a 16-week edit activity heatmap
Create templated notes and capture timestamped lines to today's daily note
extras: Bilingual interface (English and Chinese) that follows Obsidian's language setting; fully functional on mobile; settings are backed up daily automatically.
problem: Obsidian opens on the last-used tab with no overview of important or recently edited notes when you start a session.
summary: Startup homepage that replaces new tabs with a dashboard of vault statistics, pinned notes, recent notes, search, and quick note creation.
